title: Hue Festival is still on the calendar
summary: Festival Huế 2026 runs through a countdown on 31 December. October sits in the winter season of that plan. The June arts week is over, and any date after 2026 is check on arrival.
when: Through 31 December 2026. Later years: check on arrival.
photoAlt: Ngọ Môn gate at the Hue citadel
body: Hue still has a festival year on the books. The People’s Committee plan of 31 December 2025 sets Festival Huế 2026 as one chain: it opened at Ngọ Môn on 1 January and it ends with a countdown on 31 December. The same plan splits the year into four seasons. October is in the winter block, months 10 through 12.

The arts week inside that year, with Hoàng cung Huyền Dạ, was 13–18 June. That week has passed. The culture department’s note of 5 January confirms the opening at Ngọ Môn and the four-season shape. The plan does not print a visitor ticket, so a fee is check on arrival. Nothing in the 2026 plan sets the dates for a later year.

sources.label: Hue Department of Culture, Sports and Tourism, 5 January 2026
